query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

action.query: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026
queries: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026

annotations.title: How unemployment insurance benefits are determined | Mass.gov

content.text:
In **Massachusetts**, the current maximum regular unemployment benefit is **$1,105 per week**.

You can generally collect for up to **30 weeks**, so the most you could receive in regular UI is about:

**$1,105 × 30 = $33,150 total**

Your actual amount depends on your prior wages; Massachusetts says weekly benefits are generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at the state maximum. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

Also note: this is **unemployment insurance**, not Massachusetts PFML, which has a different 2026 maximum.
